objectives.title: Gather wood
objectives.note: Teaches Interact; one or two trees.

objectives.title: Eat something
objectives.note: A new world starts the player below the eating line (Player.NewWorldEnergy), so the first food carried, such as the apples gather-wood rewards, is eaten at once. It used to be a minute's wait for hunger.

objectives.title: Found a settlement
objectives.note: Fast when the wood was gathered while waiting to eat.

objectives.title: Reach the Village era
objectives.note: The Village era (EraRules): a village, 10 members, 2 stalls and day 2. Aimed at 7-15 minutes of play: the courting bot meets the rest within two minutes and waits for day 2 (7m 00s from the start, 6m 33s to 6m 47s after the previous step on seeds 1 to 5); a player who never courts gets there in 7m 00s to 11m 11s on seeds 1 to 10, held by the members on 5 of them (re-measured for #371 on 0.8.1-SNAPSHOT; docs/PACING.md, Recruiting). It was day 3 (17 minutes) until #352 found the wait for it was 14 minutes with nothing to do. Under 5 minutes would mean the era no longer waits for its day.

objectives.title: Sell resources at market
objectives.note: Waits for a settler to buy a stall and earn coins to pay with.

objectives.title: Grow your nation to 34
objectives.note: Advisory. The target is the nation's members when the ambition appears plus 5, never below the era's floor (ScaledAmbition): it was "Grow your nation to 16", met within a second on every seed. Now 34 to 40 members on seeds 1 to 5 (23 on seed 2) and 35 to 127 s (docs/PACING.md, Ambitions). Once no stranger is left it asks for 3 more buildings instead.

objectives.title: Amass 1200 coins
objectives.note: Advisory. The target is the nation's funds when the ambition appears plus a fifth (at least 500), rounded up to a hundred, never below the era's floor of 1,000: 1,100 to 1,400 on seeds 1 to 5, 37 to 68 s. It was a flat 1,000, met within a second on three seeds of five without courting.

objectives.title: Put up 29 buildings
objectives.note: One settlement more than the nation holds; at the Village era's limit of three, 3 more buildings than it has. It was "Hold 3 settlements", met within a second on four seeds of five; now 6 to 30 s.

objectives.title: Reach the Town era
objectives.note: The Town era: a town, 18 members, 2 settlements, 1,000 funds and day 4. Aimed at about half an hour (it was day 7, and the bot waited 47 minutes on the calendar alone); see docs/PACING.md for the measured times. Often reached before the ambition comes up, so no minimum. Advisory: on some seeds recruiting stalls short of 18 members.

objectives.title: Put up 35 buildings
objectives.note: Advisory. The members ambition of the Town era. By then no stranger is left on any seed, so it asks for 3 more buildings (room for births and newcomers) rather than members, which then barely grow: asked for 5 more, the bot sat on "Grow your nation to 87" for three and a half hours. It was "Grow your nation to 25", met within a second on every seed, against a minimum of 300 s that this entry had only because it was advisory. Now 6 to 34 s: the bot builds as soon as it is asked and has the stone, so no minimum.

milestones.title: The rule passes to an heir
